title: Answering Common Job Interview Questions
summary: Learn how to answer three common job interview questions. You will practice talking about your skills and goals.

sections.p: This is usually the first question in an interview. Interviewers want a short summary of your professional life. Talk about your current job, your past experience, and why you are here today. Keep your answer under two minutes. Focus on work, not your personal life.

ex.en: I have worked as a customer service agent for three years.
ex.mean: I have three years of experience helping customers.

ex.en: In my last job, I managed a team of five people.
ex.mean: Previously, I was the boss of five workers.

ex.en: I am looking for a new challenge in marketing.
ex.mean: I want a new job where I can do marketing work.

sections.p: When interviewers ask about your strengths, they want to know what you do very well. Choose two or three positive skills that match the job. Always give a quick example to prove your strength is real.

ex.en: I am very organized and I never miss a deadline.
ex.mean: I plan my work well and always finish on time.
I am very good at finding solutions to difficult issues.

ex.en: I communicate well with different types of people.
ex.mean: It is easy for me to talk and work with everyone.

sections.h: Why do you want this job?
sections.p: Companies want to hire people who actually care about their business. Research the company before the interview. Explain how your goals match the company's goals and why you are excited to work there.

ex.en: I love your company's focus on green technology.
ex.mean: I like that your business cares about the environment.

ex.en: This role is a great match for my skills.
ex.mean: My abilities are perfect for this position.

ex.en: I want to grow my career with your team.
ex.mean: I want to learn and get better while working here.

tip: Practice your answers out loud in front of a mirror. Recording your voice on your phone helps you speak more slowly and clearly.
